provenance.notes: Built entirely from already-frozen, already-manifested source outputs -- no source extraction occurred during this phase. Fully reproducible via: python scripts/build_integrated_pilot.py (then python scripts/audit_integrated_pilot.py, python scripts/test_integration.py). data/weather_state.py's target_date parameterization (the one code change made to existing validated logic) is included in this same commit.

target.label_definition: Realized Central Park/KNYC daily maximum temperature (ISD observations, is_real_observation=True rows only). KLGA/KJFK/KEWR are auxiliary predictors only, never averaged into the target. Kalshi settlement-station reconciliation is explicitly out of scope for this dataset.

query_time_schedule.timezone: America/New_York (DST-correct via zoneinfo, no hardcoded UTC offset)

state_construction.core_rule: ATOMIC WITHIN SOURCE, ASYNCHRONOUS ACROSS SOURCES -- see docs/live_information_state.md
state_construction.eligibility_rule: available_time <= query_time (never run_time or valid_time) for every S3_LAST_MODIFIED_PROXY source; observation_time / issuance_time as documented proxies, PROXY mode only
state_construction.integration_fix: get_latest_forecast/get_ensemble_state/get_observation_state/get_target_day_progress gained a backward-compatible optional target_date parameter (previously hardcoded to the single feasibility-test-era date 2025-07-01)

label_methodology.computation: max(temperature_f) over all is_real_observation=True KNYC rows within the NYC-local target day, independent of query_time
label_methodology.hard_constraint: KNYC_tmax_so_far_f (a feature) can never exceed label_tmax_f (the label) -- verified 0 violations across all 480 states

source_availability_methodologies.gefs: S3_LAST_MODIFIED_PROXY, NORMAL confidence, per-member/per-FH granularity preserved
source_availability_methodologies.ecmwf_deterministic: S3_LAST_MODIFIED_PROXY, LOW confidence (bulk archive-sync event, not genuine per-forecast-hour dissemination -- see docs/ecmwf_pilot_readiness.md)

known_limitations: ECMWF ensemble, AIFS, and additional numerical-weather providers are out of scope
This is a 40-day methodology-validation prototype, not the final multi-year training dataset
AFD availability in this sample (100% under PROXY) should not be assumed at true backfill scale (irregular issuance cadence)

data/weather_state.py's get_observation_state/get_afd_state internal provenance.source_file fields still reference the original single-day feasibility-test paths (cosmetic only; state_index.parquet is the authoritative provenance record)
reproducibility_command: python scripts/build_integrated_pilot.py && python scripts/audit_integrated_pilot.py && python scripts/test_integration.py
